requirements.text: normalize_record(record) returns a shallow copy with a stripped nonempty string id; timestamp must be a nonnegative integer excluding bool, and capability_score must be a finite number in [0,1] excluding bool; reject invalid or missing fields with ValueError and preserve extra fields.

read_records(text) processes nonblank JSON lines in order, returning (valid_records, invalid_line_numbers); invalid JSON or record validation failures are reported using one-based physical line numbers, and blank lines are ignored.
latest_records(records) keeps the greatest-timestamp record per id, choosing the last input record on equal timestamps, and returns shallow copies sorted by id without mutating input.
group_means(records) returns a dictionary of arithmetic mean capability_score by group, using the string 'default' when group is absent and returning an empty dictionary for empty input.
